16041-the-grey-cloak.title: The Grey Cloak
16041-the-grey-cloak.creator: Harold Macgrath
16041-the-grey-cloak.description: A book by Harold Macgrath. The author has taken a few liberties with the lives of various historical personages who pass through these pages; but only for the story's sake. He is also indebted to the Jesuit Relations, to Old Paris, by Lady Jackson, and to Clark's History of Onondaga, the legend of Hiawatha being taken from the last named volume.

arxiv-2008-04229.title: Decision Conflict, Logit, and the Outside Option
arxiv-2008-04229.creator: Georgios Gerasimou
arxiv-2008-04229.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Georgios Gerasimou. Decision makers often opt for the deferral outside option when they find it difficult to make an active choice. Contrary to existing logit models with an outside option where the latter is assigned a fixed value exogenously, this paper introduces and analyzes a class of logit models where that option’s value is menu-dependent, may be determined endogenously, and could be interpreted as proxying the varying degree of decision difficulty at different menus.

arxiv-2101-05240.title: Estimating causes of maternal death in data-sparse contexts
arxiv-2101-05240.creator: Monica Alexander, Michael Y.C. Chong, Marija Pejcinovska
arxiv-2101-05240.description: Abstract Understanding the underlying causes of maternal death across all regions of the world is essential to inform policies and resource allocation to reduce the mortality burden. However, in many countries there exists very little data on the causes of maternal death, and data that do exist do not capture the entire population at risk.

arxiv-2107-09457.title: Inflation with Gauss-Bonnet and Chern-Simons higher-curvature-corrections in the view of GW170817
arxiv-2107-09457.creator: S.A. Venikoudis, F.P. Fronimos
arxiv-2107-09457.description: Abstract Inflationary era of our Universe can be characterized as semi-classical because it can be described in the context of four-dimensional Einstein’s gravity involving quantum corrections. These string motivated corrections originate from quantum theories of gravity such as superstring theories and include higher gravitational terms as, Gauss-Bonnet and Chern-Simons terms.

arxiv-2202-06605.title: Hybrid Soft Robots Incorporating Soft and Stiff Elements
arxiv-2202-06605.creator: Dimuthu D. K. Arachchige, Isuru S. Godage
arxiv-2202-06605.description: Abstract Soft robots are inherently compliant and have a strong potential to realize human-friendly and safe robots. Despite continued research highlighting the potential of soft robots, they remain largely confined to laboratory settings. In this work, inspired by spider monkeys’ tails, we propose a hybrid soft robot (HSR) design.

arxiv-2212-05122.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yifan Gong ∗1 , Zheng Zhan ∗1 , Pu Zhao 1 , Yushu Wu 1 , Chao Wu 1 , Caiwen Ding 2 , Weiwen Jiang 3 , Minghai Qin 1 , Yanzhi Wang 1. During the deployment of deep neural networks (DNNs) on edge devices, many research efforts are devoted to the limited hardware resource. However, little attention is paid to the influence of dynamic power management.

arxiv-2305-16848.title: Perturbative aspects of mass dimension one fermions non-minimally coupled to electromagnetic field
arxiv-2305-16848.creator: Willian Carvalho, M. Dias, A. C. Lehum, J. M. Hoff da Silva
arxiv-2305-16848.description: Abstract This paper addresses perturbative aspects of the renormalization of a fermion with mass dimension one non-minimally coupled to the electromagnetic field. Specifically, we calculate the one-loop corrections to the propagators and vertex functions of the model and determine the one-loop beta function of the non-minimal electromagnetic coupling.

arxiv-2310-16147.title: PreWoMe: Exploiting Presuppositions as Working Memory for Long Form Question Answering
arxiv-2310-16147.creator: Wookje Han, Jinsol Park, Kyungjae Lee
arxiv-2310-16147.description: Abstract Information-seeking questions in long-form question answering (LFQA) often prove misleading due to ambiguity or false presupposition in the question. While many existing approaches handle misleading questions, they are tailored to limited questions, which are insufficient in a real-world setting with unpredictable input characteristics.

arxiv-2411-19557.title: Initialization using Update Approximation is a Silver Bullet for Extremely Efficient Low-Rank Fine-Tuning
arxiv-2411-19557.creator: Kaustubh Ponkshe, Raghav Singhal, Eduard Gorbunov, Alexey Tumanov, Samuel Horvath, Praneeth Vepakomma
arxiv-2411-19557.description: Abstract Low-rank adapters have become standard for efficiently fine-tuning large language models, but they often fall short of achieving the performance of full fine-tuning. We propose a method, LoRA S ilver B ullet or LoRA-SB , that approximates full fine-tuning within low-rank subspaces using a carefully designed initialization strategy.

arxiv-2508-12869.title: Adaptive Uniform Weighting: Pre-conditioning to Improve Image Fidelity
arxiv-2508-12869.creator: Robert Braun
arxiv-2508-12869.description: Abstract Context. The ”dirty” image made by direct Fourier inversion of visibility data is an important first step in inteferometric imaging. This is where the ”deconvolution problem” is defined and the degree to which that problem is either well- or ill-conditioned has direct consequences for the ultimate image fidelity that is achieved in practise. Aims.

arxiv-2512-10109.title: The Moroccan Public Procurement Game
arxiv-2512-10109.creator: Nizar Riane
arxiv-2512-10109.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the public procurement market through the lens of game theory by modeling it as a strategic game with discontinuous and non-quasiconcave payoffs. We first show that the game admits no Nash equilibrium in pure strategies.

arxiv-2512-12176.title: Constraining the dark matter origin of the halo-like 20 GeV γ \gamma -ray excess with the AMS-02 antiproton data
arxiv-2512-12176.creator: Kai-Kai Duan*
arxiv-2512-12176.description: Abstract Very recently, a significant ∼ 20 \sim 20 GeV gamma-ray excess in the Milky Way halo has been reported and a dark matter origin has been suggested. The inferred dark matter parameters are m χ ∼ 0.5 − 0.8 m_{\chi}\sim 0.5-0.

arxiv-2601-19857.title: Symmetric and Antisymmetric Quantum States from Graph Structure and Orientation
arxiv-2601-19857.creator: Matheus R. de Jesus, Eduardo O. C. Hoefel, Renato M. Angelo
arxiv-2601-19857.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Matheus R. de Jesus, Eduardo O. C. Hoefel, Renato M. Angelo. Graph states provide a powerful framework for describing multipartite entanglement in quantum information science. In their standard formulation, graph states are generated by controlled- Z Z interactions and naturally encode symmetric exchange properties. Here we establish a precise correspondence between graph topology and exchange symmetry by proving that a graph state is fully symmetric under particle permutations if and only if the underlying graph is complete.

pmc-11238773.creator: Xin Yang, Zeng-Xiang Wang, Yu-Xing Tian, Chao Peng, Hui-Ning Yang, Ying Wu

This work explored the effects of cognitive behavior therapy (CBT)-based comprehensive nursing intervention (CNI) mode in arch expansion to treat patients with orthodontic osteodilated arch (OOA).AIMTo explore the application effect of CBT-based CNI model in orthodontic expansion arch treatment.METHODSUsing convenient sampling method, 81 patients with OOA were selected and rolled into a control group (Ctrl group, 40 cases) and an observation group (Obs group, 41 cases).

pmc-11413848.title: Quantitative Assessment of Collagen Remodeling during a Murine Pregnancy
pmc-11413848.creator: Jessica C Ramella-Roman, Mala Mahendroo, Clothilde Raoux, Gaël Latour, Marie-Claire Schanne-Klein
pmc-11413848.description: Uterine cervical remodeling is a fundamental feature of pregnancy, facilitating the delivery of the fetus through the cervical canal. Yet, we still know very little about this process due to the lack of methodologies that can quantitatively and unequivocally pinpoint the changes the cervix undergoes during pregnancy.

pmc-11476984.title: NBF2, an Algal Fiber-Rich Formula, Reverses Diabetic Dyslipidemia and Hyperglycemia In Vivo
pmc-11476984.creator: Nlandu Roger Ngatu, Akram Hossain, Nao Maruo, Steeve Akumwami, Asadur Md. Rahman, Masamitsu Eitoku, Kanae Kanda, Akira Nishiyama, Narufumi Suganuma, Tomohiro Hirao
pmc-11476984.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ulva prolifera, known as Aonori in Japan, is an edible alga species that is mass-cultivated in Japan. Supplementation with Aonori-derived biomaterials has been reported to enhance metabolic health in previous studies. This was an experimental study that evaluated the metabolic health effects of NBF2, a formula made of algal and junos Tanaka citrus-derived biomaterials, on obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2DM).

pmc-11481111.title: Challenge of cardiovascular prevention in primary care: achievement of lifestyle, blood pressure, lipids and diabetes targets for primary prevention in England – results from ASPIRE-3-PREVENT cross-sectional survey
pmc-11481111.creator: Kornelia Kotseva, Catriona Jennings, Paul Bassett, Agnieszka Adamska, Richard Hobbs, David Wood, ASPIRE-3-PREVENT Investigators
pmc-11481111.description: BackgroundImplementation of the cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention guidelines in the UK has been repeatedly evaluated under the auspices of the British Cardiovascular Society in three Action on Secondary and Primary Prevention by Intervention to Reduce Events (ASPIRE) surveys in 1994–1995, 2008–2010 and 2017–2019.

pmc-11565381.title: Depression predicts decreased lumbar bone mineral density: A scoping review of chronic psychological stress and spinal tissue pathology
pmc-11565381.creator: Mary A Bucklin, Eric C Gehrke, Jennifer C Westrick, Michael Gottlieb, John T Martin
pmc-11565381.description: ObjectiveChronic low back pain (cLBP) is a complex disease with biological, psychological, and social components and the complex interactions of these components are poorly understood. Chronic psychological stress (CPS) (anxiety, depression, etc.) and pathological changes in spinal tissue (osteoporosis, disc degeneration, etc.) are frequently and independently associated with cLBP, yet their explicit relationship has not been collectively reviewed.

pmc-11758505.title: Vein watershed analysis locational method versus computed tomography-guided percutaneous localization for detecting non-palpable peripheral pulmonary nodules: a real-world study of non-inferiority
pmc-11758505.creator: Chen Huang, Zi-Hao Chen, Li-Shan Peng, Jia-Tao Zhang, Jun-Tao Lin, Sheng Zhang, Jie Yang, Ben-Yuan Jiang, Xue-Ning Yang, Wen-Zhao Zhong, Qiang Nie
pmc-11758505.description: OBJECTIVESIn recent years, with the advancement of sublobar resection, a safe, painless method for locating peripheral pulmonary nodules was needed. Previously, an alternative method of arterial watershed localization was introduced to remedy the shortcomings of preoperative computed tomography (CT)-guided localization or other methods for locating pulmonary nodules, but its technical limitations were discovered during clinical applications.

pmc-12374805.title: Retrospective Evaluation of the Impact of a Multidisciplinary One-Year Online Lifestyle Intervention on Type 2 Diabetes Remission in Nonobese Indian Patients
pmc-12374805.creator: Pramod Tripathi, Anagha Vyawahare, Nidhi Kadam, Diptika Tiwari, Baby Sharma, Thejas Kathrikolly, Malhar Ganla, Banshi Saboo
pmc-12374805.description: Background and Objective: Despite the high prevalence of T2D among nonobese Indians, there is a notable lack of comprehensive lifestyle intervention studies that target this population. This retrospective study was aimed at filling this gap by evaluating the impact of a multidisciplinary 1-year online intensive lifestyle intervention (ILI) on T2D remission in nonobese Indian patients.

pmc-12501177.title: Ectopic transcription due to inherited histone methylation may interfere with the ongoing function of differentiated neurons
pmc-12501177.creator: Juan D. Rodriguez, Monica N. Reeves, Sindy R. Chavez, Hsiao-Lin V. Wang, Jaely Z. Chavez, Rhea Rastogi, Liyang I. Sun, Mackenzie S. Roberson, Elicia A. Preston, Zaynab Massenburg, Kiani N. Cruz, Madhav S. Chadha, Emily J. Hill, Miguel L. Soares, Victor G. Corces, Brandon S. Carpenter, Karen L. Schme
pmc-12501177.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SignificanceInheritance of inappropriate chromatin in a double mutant between two histone modifying enzymes in Caenorhabditis elegans causes abnormal chemotaxis behavior in the progeny due to the widespread inappropriate expression of germline genes. We found that the behavior is abnormal despite there being no defects in neurodevelopment and that the abnormal behavior can be reverted by turning off the inappropriate germline transcription after the nervous system has fully formed.

pmc-12618718.title: Contextual factors influencing neuro-affirming practice: Identifying what helps or hinders implementation in health and social care
pmc-12618718.creator: Anna Gray, Donald Maciver, Eleanor Curnow, Lorna Johnston, Marion Rutherford
pmc-12618718.description: There has been limited research to date into contextual factors hindering or supporting the successful implementation of neuro-affirming practice in support for Autistic and otherwise neurodivergent adults. We used a Realist Evaluation approach to explore key contexts affecting neuro-affirming practice. A preliminary programme theory of key aspects of support was developed.

pmc-13265728.creator: Muhammad Farooq Siddique, Wasim Zaman, Muhammad Khalid, Bayan Hamdan, Jong-Myon Kim
pmc-13265728.description: The transition of industrial maintenance toward intelligent and autonomous operation requires non-destructive evaluation frameworks that remain reliable under variable operating conditions and limited labeled data. pmc-13337337.title: Cyclic Electron Transport via the NDH Complex Sustains Photosynthesis and Productivity Under Fluctuating and Sub‐Optimal Environments
pmc-13337337.creator: Hiromasa Kodama, Wataru Yamori
pmc-13337337.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The chloroplast NADH dehydrogenase‐like (NDH) complex mediates cyclic electron transport (CET) around photosystem I (PSI) and contributes to photosynthetic regulation and photoprotection under various environmental stresses. Although NDH function has been extensively characterized under controlled conditions, NDH‐deficient mutants often show only subtle phenotypes in such environments, leaving its physiological importance to photosynthesis in plants grown under naturally fluctuating field conditions poorly understood. Here, we evaluated growth, yield, and photosynthetic performance of NDH‐deficient rice cultivated in outdoor fields.

pmc-13623894.title: Smartphones in the classroom: power tool or source of distraction? Evidence from a cross-lagged panel study
pmc-13623894.creator: Xiaogang Li, Liping Chen
pmc-13623894.description: BackgroundThe widespread use of mobile devices in educational settings suggests that smartphones may function both as learning tools and as potential sources of distraction. Existing cross-sectional studies have been unable to adequately explain the dynamic causal relationships among technology acceptance, digital distraction, and academic engagement.

pmc-13634744.title: Catch damage in broiler chickens: a systematic review of injury assessment methods and their limitations
pmc-13634744.creator: Patryk Sztandarski, Joanna Marchewka, Aneta Jaszczyk, Magdalena Solka, Jarosław O Horbańczuk, Anja B Riber, Frank AM Tuyttens, T Bas Rodenburg

pmc-13649832.title: Capturing the Multiscale Nature of Bone Behavior: Classical, Data-Driven and Hybrid Techniques
pmc-13649832.creator: Melika Mohammadkhah, Ardeshir Savari, Sandra Klinge
pmc-13649832.description: AbstractThe complexities of bone architecture, with its hierarchical organization and varying spatiotemporal scales, necessitate advanced modeling techniques to capture its mechanical behavior precisely. This review aims to highlight recent trends in capturing the multiscale nature of bone using two primary computational approaches: classical and data-driven frameworks.

uslaw-usc-t14-s1103.title: 14 U.S.C. § 1103 — Role of Vice Commandant in major acquisition programs
uslaw-usc-t14-s1103.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s1103.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 11 (Acquisitions); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Vice Commandant— (1) shall represent the customer of a major acquisition program with regard to trade-offs made among cost, schedule, technical feasibility, and performance with respect to such program; and (2) shall advise the Commandant in decisions regarding the balancing of resources.
